data.one_liner: Cross-platform Matomo tracking client for analytics in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the Matomo Tracking API to send page views, goals, and events from a Flutter application. Supports global or local route observation, custom dimensions, cookieless tracking, and persistent dispatch queues.
use_when: You need to integrate Matomo analytics into your Flutter cross-platform app.
You require automatic screen tracking via navigator observers or specific widget/state mixins.
avoid_when: You prefer using a different analytics platform such as Firebase or Sentry.
You do not use Matomo as your analytics backend.
strengths: Fully cross-platform support (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Offers both global and local navigator observers as well as state mixins for precise tracking.
Supports persistent dispatching so queued actions aren't lost if the app terminates.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Matomo tracking API ecosystem.
Requires proper configuration of site ID and tracking endpoints.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the tracker early in your application lifecycle with your site ID and Matomo URL endpoint.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you want error tracking, crash reporting, and performance monitoring instead of web/app usage analytics.

alternatives.name: mixpanel_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you prefer Mixpanel as your product analytics platform.
